basic_details.job_title: NIT Agartala Technical Assistant Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technology Agartala (NIT Agartala) Technical Assistant Trainee Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of NIT Agartala. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced through the NIT Agartala Technical Assistant Trainee Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology/Data Science/AI or MCA, First Division (60% or 6.5 CGPA), Graduated in 2024/2025/2026
qualification.details: First Division (60% or 6.5 CGPA) in B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology/Data Science/AI/ Any other specialization in the CS domain or MCA from a recognized Indian university. Graduated in 2024, 2025 or 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Agartala to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Agartala Technical Assistant Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Technical Assistant Trainee posts at NIT Agartala is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant Trainee post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Technical Assistant Trainee post announced by NIT Agartala in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Technology/Data Science/AI or MCA with First Division (60% or 6.5 CGPA) and graduated in 2024, 2025, or 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technical Assistant Trainee position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Technical Assistant Trainee post is 24 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant Trainee role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Assistant Trainee position will involve a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NIT Agartala Technical Assistant Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications for the Technical Assistant Trainee posts must be submitted online through the official website of NIT Agartala.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Technical Assistant Trainee position is a contractual role, offered as a fixed-period internship.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Agartala located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Agartala is located in Agartala, Tripura, with the pincode 799046.
